scope: Free, no-LLM comparison of StopCube remain-static execution semantics

official_source.behavior: When an on-menu choice returns batch == 0, MEMI records result=no_op. Its comment names StopCube remain static after the last checkpoint and states that no simulator step ran; because no rows are appended, the next policy call renders the same decision step.

arbiter_source.behavior: The harness uses the same rule: an on-menu zero-batch command is no_op; zero captured rows are appended to the timeline, so the next request reuses the last step.

released_log_evidence.inspection: Field-only inspection (task/action/time/result/batch/captured; no goal or observation text) found published StopCube remain-static decisions recorded as result=no_op, batch=0, captured=0, followed by an empty timeline range rather than advancing simulator time.
released_log_evidence.restriction: No local held-out episode was run or read. The released logs were not copied into this repository.

action: No executor change. G1's repeated remain-static loop is consistent with MEMI's official executor semantics; describe it as an official no-op/task-policy interaction, not as proof from the G1 symptom alone.
